gate_results.name: rule_compliance
gate_results.rationale: This geometry and speed teacher uses privileged TRAIN-only state and is not a submission candidate.

gate_results.name: mechanism_activation
gate_results.rationale: Visual obstacle lockout returned control to the pixel driver on 1881 decisions. On other decisions the teacher raised gas 1018 times and coasted 214 times, with zero invalid actions.

gate_results.name: competitive_or_product_outcome
gate_results.rationale: Both arms completed 11/12, but the candidate alone failed 1:5008 off track at 95.65% progress without collisions while control finished. On ten jointly finished cells, candidate median lap was 23.18 versus 23.74 seconds, only 2.36% faster, below the preregistered 3% gate. The candidate-only nonfinish independently fails the completion gate.
